column2: This character is a knight, a steadfast champion bound by sacred oath, martial discipline, and an unshakable code of honor.
This character is a mage, a seeker of hidden truths who bends intrigue and arcane knowledge to subtle and calculated ends.
This character is a craftsman, a diligent artisan and shrewd trader whose practiced hands and measured diplomacy shape wealth, forge partnerships, and raise enduring works.
